mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the three shapes separately made the colour cell’s construction easy to follow; attaching it to the viewing tube then brought the parts together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the light cover was clear, but less visually informative because it concealed the shapes already added.

surprise.text: The shapes appeared only faintly beneath the clear lid; I expected them to remain more visible.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each followed an explicit construction goal, although the text did not explain how the light cover works.

continue.text: I would continue to see another mechanism come together, though the straightforward sequence offered little choice. This text trial cannot tell me how the pictures or handling feel.
